_doc: Vendored from awasfie/salesos ops/rls-audit/targets.json (timeway entry only; host, cluster and runtime-app ids omitted: --dsn mode only, never --live from this repo). Keep in sync with salesos; the salesos copy is the source of truth for the live audit.

databases._doc: TW-T9.2d: tenant tables = tw_* (orgId/id) + the five Cal.com tables carrying twOrgId (users, EventType, Booking, Schedule, Credential). Every other Cal.com table is listed in exempt with its reason; they gain twOrgId + policy in the TW-T9 contract slice.
